katakanaLessons.title: Vowels (アイウエオ)
katakanaLessons.description: The five basic vowel sounds in katakana. These are the foundation for all other characters.

ア.tips: Start with the top horizontal stroke, then the angled vertical.
ア.mnemonics: A samurai's sword cutting down from an 'A' shape.
writingPattern: Start at top-left, draw short horizontal line to the right.
From the middle-right of the first stroke, draw a long diagonal down and to the left.

イ.tips: Keep strokes symmetrical like a roof.
イ.mnemonics: Two priests meditating side-by-side (they look like a 'roof').
writingPattern: Start at top-left, draw a slanted stroke down and to the right.
Start slightly right of the first, draw a parallel slanted stroke down and to the left.

ウ.tips: The top is a dot, the second stroke is a curve, the third is a long downward line.
ウ.mnemonics: A crow sitting on a tree branch.
writingPattern: Draw a small dot at the top.
Start below the dot, draw a curve to the right and down.
Start at the bottom of the curve, draw a long diagonal down to the left.

エ.tips: Draw the top and middle lines first, then the vertical stroke.
エ.mnemonics: An 'E' (English letter) without its right side.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal line at the top center.
Draw a slightly longer horizontal line in the middle center.
Draw a vertical line from the top to the bottom, crossing the two horizontals.

オ.tips: Draw the vertical line first for balance.
オ.mnemonics: A compass pointing North, with a wave at the bottom.
writingPattern: Draw a short vertical line from top-center down.
Draw a horizontal line crossing the middle of the vertical.
Draw a curved hook at the bottom of the vertical, sweeping right.

katakanaLessons.title: K-Row (カキクケコ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'k' consonant. These characters follow the sharp, straight aesthetic of katakana.

カ.tips: Draw the long curve first, then the horizontal line crossing it.
カ.mnemonics: A sharp knife cutting a piece of fruit.
writingPattern: Draw a long slanted stroke from top-right down to bottom-left.
Draw a short horizontal stroke starting from the middle of the first, going left.

キ.tips: The top two strokes are a set, the bottom two are a set.
キ.mnemonics: A key turned sideways, with the teeth pointing down.
writingPattern: Draw a long vertical line from top-center down.
Draw a short horizontal line crossing the top of the vertical.
Draw a second horizontal line below the first.
Draw a short slanted stroke starting from the bottom-left of the vertical.

ク.tips: Draw the sweeping curve first, then the little dot/tick.
ク.mnemonics: A bird pecking at the ground (the tick is its foot).
writingPattern: Draw a curved line from top-right sweeping down to bottom-left.
Draw a small diagonal tick at the bottom-right of the curve.

ケ.tips: Make the left stroke distinct from the right sweep.
ケ.mnemonics: A bird looking back over its shoulder (the extra stroke is its head).
writingPattern: Draw a short slanted stroke from top-left down to the left.
Draw a curved line from top-right sweeping down to bottom-left.
Draw a small diagonal tick at the bottom-right of the curve.

コ.tips: Draw the top line first, then the bottom. Keep them parallel.
コ.mnemonics: A mouth open wide (C shape) but with a flat top.
writingPattern: Draw a long horizontal line at the top.
Draw a longer horizontal line at the bottom.

katakanaLessons.title: S-Row (サシスセソ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 's' consonant. Pay close attention to the difference between 'シ' (shi) and 'ツ' (tsu), which are easily confused.

サ.tips: Draw the top line, then the two vertical lines dropping from it.
サ.mnemonics: A table with two wooden legs.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line at the top.
Draw a slanted vertical line from the left side of the top line down.
Draw a slanted vertical line from the right side of the top line down.

シ.tips: All three strokes are horizontal dashes stacked vertically but shifted right.
シ.mnemonics: Three rain drops falling sideways in a strong wind.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal dash at the top-left.
Draw a longer horizontal dash below it, slightly to the right.
Draw a long sweeping diagonal from bottom-left up to the right.

ス.tips: Draw the top hook, then the sweeping curve at the bottom.
ス.mnemonics: A hanger with a small hook at the bottom.
writingPattern: Draw a small diagonal hook at the top-left.
Draw a long curve starting from the hook, sweeping down and to the right.

セ.tips: Draw the sweeping curve first, then the top horizontal line.
セ.mnemonics: An uppercase 'L' wearing a baseball cap.
writingPattern: Draw a long sweeping vertical line from top-right down to bottom-left.
Draw a horizontal line at the top, crossing the start of the vertical.

ソ.tips: Two strokes: a top dot and a long sweeping curve.
ソ.mnemonics: A comma floating above a wave.
writingPattern: Draw a short diagonal dash at the top-right.
Draw a long sweeping curve from just below the dash down to the bottom-left.

katakanaLessons.title: T-Row (タチツテト)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 't' consonant. Note the unique sounds 'chi' and 'tsu'.

タ.tips: Draw the top line, then the two vertical strokes (one short, one long).
タ.mnemonics: A person holding a long spear.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line at the top.
From the left side, draw a short slanted stroke down.
From the right side, draw a long sweeping curve down.

チ.tips: Draw the top horizontal, then the long vertical, then the hook.
チ.mnemonics: A number '5' with a longer tail.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal line near the top.
Draw a long vertical line downwards from the middle of the horizontal.
Draw a small diagonal hook at the bottom right of the vertical.

ツ.tips: All strokes are horizontal dashes. Key difference from シ: they are aligned vertically.
ツ.mnemonics: A bird's footprint in the snow, heading down.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal dash at the top-right.
Draw a longer horizontal dash below it.
Draw a long sweeping diagonal from top-left down to bottom-right.

テ.tips: Draw the vertical first, then the top horizontal, then the bottom hook.
テ.mnemonics: A tree branch (horizontal) with a twig (vertical) and a leaf (hook).
writingPattern: Draw a short vertical line at the center.
Draw a horizontal line crossing the top of the vertical.
Draw a small diagonal hook at the bottom left of the vertical.

ト.tips: Draw the long vertical, then the short horizontal.
ト.mnemonics: A walking stick with a small foot.
writingPattern: Draw a long vertical line from top to bottom.
Draw a short horizontal line crossing the vertical at the bottom.

katakanaLessons.title: N-Row (ナニヌネノ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'n' consonant. These characters are relatively simple but distinct.

ナ.tips: Draw the sweeping vertical first, then the horizontal crossing it.
ナ.mnemonics: A cross where the bottom part is longer than the top.
writingPattern: Draw a long vertical line starting at the top-center, curving slightly left.
Draw a horizontal line crossing the vertical about 1/3 of the way down.

ニ.tips: Draw two parallel horizontal lines. Top is slightly shorter.
ニ.mnemonics: Two equal-length wooden planks on a shelf.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line at the top.
Draw a slightly longer horizontal line below it.

ヌ.tips: Draw the top hook, then the long sweeping curve.
ヌ.mnemonics: A fishing hook with a line caught in it.
writingPattern: Draw a small diagonal hook at the top-left.
Draw a horizontal line from the hook to the right.
Draw a long sweeping curve from the bottom of the hook down and to the left.

ネ.tips: Draw the left vertical, then the top horizontal, then the bottom hook.
ネ.mnemonics: A tree with a branch and a small root.
writingPattern: Draw a long vertical line on the left side.
Draw a horizontal line crossing the top of the vertical.
Draw a slanted line crossing the middle of the vertical.
Draw a small diagonal hook at the bottom right.

ノ.tips: Draw in one sweeping stroke from top-left to bottom-right.
writingPattern: Draw a single sweeping curve from top-left down to bottom-right.

katakanaLessons.title: H-Row (ハヒフヘホ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'h' consonant. Watch out for フ (fu), which is unique.

ハ.tips: Draw the left stroke first, then the right. They meet at the top.
ハ.mnemonics: A small tent or mountain peak.
writingPattern: Draw a diagonal line from top-center down to the bottom-left.
Draw a second diagonal line from top-center down to the bottom-right.

ヒ.tips: Draw the left curve, then the long right stroke.
ヒ.mnemonics: A person with a big nose looking to the right.
writingPattern: Draw a short curve on the left.
Draw a long sweeping line from the top of the curve down to the right.

フ.pronunciation: Like 'foo'. This is the only 'f' sound in Japanese.
フ.tips: Draw in one smooth stroke from left to right, then hook down.
フ.mnemonics: A bent arm holding a tray of food.
writingPattern: Draw a single sweeping stroke starting horizontally left, curving up, then hooking down and to the left.

ヘ.tips: Draw in one stroke, like a check mark.
ヘ.mnemonics: A check mark. (It looks exactly like Hiragana へ).
writingPattern: Draw a single slanted stroke from top-right down to the bottom-left, with a slight curve.

ホ.tips: Draw the central vertical, then the crossbar, then the two side strokes.
ホ.mnemonics: A cross with two branches growing out of the sides.
writingPattern: Draw a long vertical line from top-center down.
Draw a horizontal line crossing the vertical in the middle.
Draw a short slanted stroke from the top-left of the vertical.
Draw a short slanted stroke from the bottom-left of the vertical.

katakanaLessons.title: M-Row (マミムメモ)
katakanaLessons.description: Adding the 'm' consonant. These characters are often visually balanced.

マ.tips: Draw the top horizontal, then the long vertical descending from it.
マ.mnemonics: A bird flying upwards, seen from below.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line at the top.
Draw a long slanted line from the middle of the top line down to the bottom-left.

ミ.tips: Draw three short diagonal dashes, stacked diagonally.
ミ.mnemonics: Three water ripples in a pond.
writingPattern: Draw a short diagonal dash at the top-right.
Draw a slightly longer dash below it.
Draw a longer dash below that, all slanting the same way.

ム.tips: Draw the long curve, then the small tick at the bottom.
ム.mnemonics: A flagpole with a pennant flying in the wind.
writingPattern: Draw a long sweeping curve from top-right down to bottom-left.
Draw a small diagonal tick at the bottom-left of the curve.

メ.tips: Draw the horizontal line, then the vertical line crossing it.
メ.mnemonics: A large 'X' with one arm shorter than the other.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line.
Draw a long diagonal line crossing the horizontal.

モ.tips: Draw the three horizontal lines, then the vertical crossing them.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal line at the top.
Draw a slightly longer horizontal line below it.
Draw a longer horizontal line below that.
Draw a vertical line crossing all three horizontals.

katakanaLessons.title: Y-Row (ヤユヨ)
katakanaLessons.description: The 'y' consonant sounds. These are used to create combined sounds (e.g., キャ, シュ, ニョ) when written smaller.

ヤ.tips: Draw the top hook, then the long vertical line.
ヤ.mnemonics: A candy cane hanging from a hook.
writingPattern: Draw a small curved hook at the top.
Draw a long vertical line dropping from the tip of the hook.

ユ.tips: Draw the top hook, then the U-shaped curve below.
ユ.mnemonics: A horseshoe with a nail at the top.
writingPattern: Draw a small diagonal hook at the top-left.
Draw a U-shaped curve starting from the hook, going down and right.

ヨ.tips: Draw three horizontal lines, each slightly longer than the one above.
ヨ.mnemonics: Three shelves, growing wider as they go down.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal line at the top.
Draw a slightly longer horizontal line below it.
Draw the longest horizontal line at the bottom.

katakanaLessons.title: R-Row (ラリルレロ)
katakanaLessons.description: The 'r' consonant. In Japanese, this is a tap sound, similar to a soft 'd' or 'l'. It's not a rolled 'r'.

ラ.pronunciation: A light tap like the 'dd' in 'ladder'.
ラ.tips: Draw the top horizontal, then the sweeping curve dropping from it.
ラ.mnemonics: A number '7' with a long, sweeping tail.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line at the top.
Draw a long sweeping curve from the center of the top line down to the bottom-left.

リ.pronunciation: A light tap like the 'dd' in 'ladder'.
リ.tips: Draw two parallel, slightly slanted vertical strokes.
writingPattern: Draw a slanted vertical line on the left.
Draw a parallel slanted vertical line on the right.

ル.pronunciation: A light tap like the 'dd' in 'ladder'.
ル.tips: Draw the top hook, then the sweeping curve with a loop at the end.
ル.mnemonics: A fishhook with a small loop at the bottom.
writingPattern: Draw a small diagonal hook at the top-left.
Draw a sweeping curve from the hook down, looping back up at the bottom.

レ.pronunciation: A light tap like the 'dd' in 'ladder'.
レ.tips: Draw in one smooth stroke, like a check mark.
レ.mnemonics: A check mark with a very long tail.
writingPattern: Draw a single sweeping stroke from top-left down to bottom-right.

ロ.pronunciation: A light tap like the 'dd' in 'ladder'.
ロ.tips: Draw a box shape, leaving the right side open.
ロ.mnemonics: A square with the right side missing.
writingPattern: Draw a horizontal line at the top.
Draw a vertical line on the left side.
Draw a horizontal line at the bottom.

katakanaLessons.title: W-Row (ワヲ)
katakanaLessons.description: The final two vowels: 'wa' and 'wo'. 'wo' is rarely used in modern Japanese.

ワ.tips: Draw the top horizontal first, then the bowl shape.
ワ.mnemonics: A bowl with a small lid on the left side.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal line at the top-left.
Draw a curved line from the end of the horizontal, sweeping down and to the right, forming a 'U' shape.

ヲ.pronunciation: Like 'wo' in 'wonder', but often just pronounced 'o'.
ヲ.tips: A complex shape: a top horizontal, a curved middle, and a right vertical.
ヲ.mnemonics: A folded chair seen from the side.
writingPattern: Draw a short horizontal line at the top-left.
Draw a curved line sweeping down and to the right.
Draw a short vertical line at the bottom-right of the curve.

katakanaLessons.title: Final Consonant (ン)
katakanaLessons.description: The only standalone consonant in Japanese. It appears at the end of syllables.

ン.tips: Draw the top diagonal dash, then the long sweeping curve.
ン.mnemonics: A lightning bolt striking the ground.
writingPattern: Draw a short diagonal dash at the top-left.
Draw a long sweeping curve from the middle of the dash down to the bottom-right.
